run_synthetic_trace_generation: run the CLI to generate synthetic distributions from a trace file using LRU stack distance profiling
create_criteo_dataset: create a CriteoDataset for the Kaggle or Terabyte dataset with optional memory mapping and train test splits
create_random_dataset: create a RandomDataset that generates uniform or synthetic input batches with configurable embedding sizes
build_criteo_data_loaders: build Criteo train and test data loaders with optional binary loader or memory mapped NPZ files
generate_uniform_input_batch: generate a uniform random input batch of dense features and sparse embedding lookup offsets and indices
